node.title: Re: Libxml parser cosuming 100% cpu
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
If you could provide something we can actually run to see the performance issues ourselves, we could provide specific suggestions - see [id://1177642]. Until then, some general optimization tips:

  • Use [mod://Devel::NYTProf] to locate the places where your code is spending the most time.
  • Consider using a different XML parser, since [mod://XML::LibXML] will load the entire DOM structure into memory by default, while [mod://XML::Twig] is geared more towards processing a large file piece by piece, without loading the whole file into memory.
  • I see you doing foreach over an array of apparently 1 million (?) lines - this means you're keeping those lines in memory. It would most likely be more efficient to use a while(<$filehandle>) loop to read the file line-by-line, without loading it all into memory.
  • I see you repeating some findnodes calls twice, causing that effort to be doubled. Consider storing the results in a local variable so you can use it more than once.

If you have a input file of 1 million lines, consider that maybe it'll just take some time to process, and that 100% CPU consumption during that time is normal.
